name: glm53_nope_sm120
purpose: Make GLM-5.3 NoPE sparse MLA (qk_rope_head_dim=0) serve on the FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120 backend on GB10 / sm121.
derived_image_local_id_read_by: docker inspect glm53-nope-sm121:w7 --format '{{.Id}} {{.RepoDigests}}' on sparklina, 2026-09-13: .Id matches and .RepoDigests is EMPTY, which is why derived_image is null.

build.contents: Python source patches only; no compile, no new wheels, no vendored serving runtime.
build.self_check: The Dockerfile's final RUN re-imports the patched module and asserts every edit landed; the build fails if the base image moves under it.

edits.what: NoPE only: return_valid_counts=True, sparse_topk_capacity = topk_indices_physical.shape[1], empty rows pointed at slot 0, sparse_mla_top_k_lens passed
THE BLOCKER: NoPE override replacing k_pe with kv_c_normed.new_zeros((T, 1, 64)), because concat_and_cache_mla hardcodes pe_dim == 64 for the packed 656 B record
FlashInfer sparse-MLA autotune warmup and fused_moe gemm autotune wedge rank 0 on SM121; skip both
PDL lowering races the KDA state kernels on SM12x; gate PDL to major in (9, 10)

not_the_fix.claim: The MiaAI-Lab 576-pad overlay is NOT this fix and porting it verbatim would be wrong for this base.
not_the_fix.why: This base's flashinfer already resolves d_qk=512 + arbitrary_fp32 to the native _MODEL_TYPE_GLM53_NOPE at topk 2176; the overlay's trim-to-2047 surgery would force 2048 where this kernel wants 2176. A dry run matched 11 of 14 of the overlay's string targets, which is the trap, not the endorsement.

checks_passed: bit-identical on repeat within an arm
a 3649-token prompt (longer than index_topk=2048) also completed
not_qualified: The 45-layer body has NEVER been served with these patches. Four layers READY is not a served model.

Eager and CUDA-graph mode do not agree numerically: logprobs differ by up to 0.67 nats on the short prompt and the text differs on the 3649-token prompt. Cause not established (--enforce-eager also disables torch.compile, so capture is confounded, and the stub's logits are nearly flat). Principle 10 wants bit-exactness with capture off. Re-measure on a real body before any KL number is taken from this lane.
No numerical fidelity check against a BF16 reference exists for this stub, and none was attempted.

No executed-activation-contract table has been re-derived against the derived image. Under principle 14 a patched runtime's contract is NOT the pinned runtime's, and this manifest asserts nothing about what the derived image executes.

The derived image exists only as a local docker image on sparklina. derived_image is null because no registry manifest digest exists; derived_image_local_id is a docker config digest and cannot be docker-pulled.
qualification.serve_sizing: The 4-layer stub's weights alone are 45.35 GiB, so --gpu-memory-utilization 0.55 was used. The full body needs its own sizing rule; 0.30 does not fit GLM.

attested_note: This patch set is RECORDED, not attested. Nothing here is derived from a machine-readable table the serving runtime publishes, so no gate may read it as a route claim (principle 14). It records what was built and what was measured, with the scope on its face.
